title: UK Sovereign AI Fund Adds £120M for British AI Companies and R&D
summary:
The British government is expanding its support for domestic artificial intelligence by increasing the budget for its sovereign fund. The additional £120m will be split between direct investment and research, with £60m targeting promising AI firms in the physical and industrial sectors and £60m for R&D procurement in areas such as healthcare and AI security.

The funding boost follows the fund's launch less than a year ago. The initiative is designed to help founders start and scale their businesses within the UK to transition innovation into operational impact.

We want to help founders start and scale in Britain, and turn innovation into impact.
